lines.text: After leaving Bethany, hungry Jesus finds only leaves on a fig tree and says, "May no one ever eat of your fruit again."
In Jerusalem, Jesus overturns the tables of the tax collectors and the seats of those selling doves in the temple courts.
Jesus says God's house will be called a house of prayer for all nations, but they made it a den of robbers.
Walking back in the morning, Thomas sees the fig tree withered from its roots and says it has withered.
